oneLiner: A decision log that captures what you decided, why, and when — so you never re-litigate the same question twice.
problem: Teams and individuals make dozens of consequential decisions every week, then lose the reasoning behind them. Without a record, context evaporates, decisions get relitigated, new teammates re-ask settled questions, and no one can trace why a past choice was made.
targetUser: Product managers, engineering leads, founders, and consultants who operate in fast-moving, meeting-heavy environments and need an auditable trail of team and personal decisions.
coreFlow: Open Decided and land on a chronological feed of recent decisions, searchable and filterable by tag, project, or status.
Click 'Log a decision' and fill a short structured form: the decision statement, the options considered, the rationale, the decider(s), and the date.
Tag the entry to a project or topic and attach links to supporting docs, threads, or tickets.
Save the entry, which appears instantly in the feed and is versioned so later edits are tracked as addenda, not silent rewrites.
Return weeks later, search by keyword or browse by project, and copy a shareable permalink to settle 'wait, why did we do this?' in seconds.

screens.name: Decision Feed
screens.purpose: Chronological, filterable list of all logged decisions with quick previews and search.

screens.name: New Decision
screens.purpose: Structured form to capture what was decided, the options, the rationale, who decided, and when.

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Full read-only view of a single decision with tags, attachments, permalink, and addendum history.

screens.name: Projects / Topics
screens.purpose: Group decisions by project or theme and browse the decision history within each.

screens.name: Search & Filters
screens.purpose: Find decisions by keyword, person, date range, tag, or status.

outOfScope: Real-time collaborative editing and multi-cursor editing
Integrations with Slack, Jira, or Notion in v1
Automated meeting transcription or AI-generated decision extraction
Approval workflows, voting, or formal sign-off chains
Analytics dashboards, ROI metrics, or decision-quality scoring
Public sharing or external guest access beyond unlisted permalinks
